Audited [zakhmi-hai-sakina.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/3/workspaces/197018ac468c4edeacab9e48feff4976/src/data/lyrics/zakhmi-hai-sakina.md) verse by verse. All 83 Roman verse lines align with the Urdu in order, including the repeated refrains.

Corrected wording and pronunciation where the Urdu supported it, including `Maara tujhe` for `مارا تجھے`, `wahi` for `وہی`, and `qaafila` for `قافلہ`. The Urdu body and other metadata are unchanged. Retained unusual source readings such as `کہ خبر` as `ke khabar` for human editorial sign-off.
